name: mediguardian
description: MediGuardian — Caring Beyond Distance. React frontend + Node.js/Express/Socket.IO backend + MongoDB + ESP32 firmware.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix simulator
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend
